translation_notes: Six independent g.query(TEXT) literals, one per hardcoded ontology file, each become s{ } called with the explicit (graph) call suffix since none of the six graphs is the block's single designated @graph. The shared `:` default prefix (http://dig.isi.edu/, taken from the string-stripping the region does on results) is hoisted to one module-level @prefix, matching what each real viz_*.ttl file itself declares.

The function had no way to receive a graph (it hardcodes six file paths and takes only `request`): restored the binding by adding six defaulted path parameters, one per ontology file, per instructions section 6 (163-region case). Called with no arguments the function behaves exactly as before.

Non-RDF context (django.shortcuts.render, apps.connaissance/commentaire.models) is out of reach outside the Django project (no settings module, no database); replaced by context.py, a minimal shim used identically by both representations that returns the render() context dict and answers the two queryset calls the region makes.

classification is minor-restructuring rather than directly-expressible only because of the added path parameters restoring the missing binding, not because of anything the language itself could not express.

repair.driver: Two calls added to the existing one: each *_path pointed at its own fixture_<name>.ttl (own class with at least two instances, Domaine included, plus one instance of each of the five other tracked classes, the class via rdfs:seeAlso, a same-local-name class in another namespace), and all six pointed at fixture_empty.ttl (zero solution for every query).
mutants_killed: each of the five later queries run on g_tache instead of its own graph (call suffix (g) mis-wired)
only the first row of qres_generation / qres_domaine consumed
repair.remaining: Classification minor-restructuring vs directly-expressible (classification-doubt du tri), non traitée. Les requêtes de l'original résolvent ':' par les liaisons du fichier parsé, la traduction par le @prefix lexical : équivalent tant que les viz_*.ttl lient ':' à http://dig.isi.edu/ (c'est le cas des six fichiers du dépôt, que l'application ne fait qu'étendre en mode 'a').
